mapper.select: select count(1) from lab_asset where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from lab_asset where del_flag = '0' and status = '2'

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as name, count(1) as value from lab_repair where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and applicant_id = #{applicantId} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by min(create_time)
select fault_level as name, count(1) as value from lab_repair where del_flag = '0' and applicant_id = #{applicantId} group by fault_level order by fault_level

select ifnull(room.room_name, '未分配实验室') as name, count(1) as value from lab_repair r left join lab_asset a on a.asset_id = r.asset_id left join lab_room room on room.room_id = a.room_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.applicant_id = #{applicantId} group by ifnull(room.room_name, '未分配实验室') order by value desc limit 8

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as name, ifnull(sum(repair_cost), 0) as value from lab_repair where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and applicant_id = #{applicantId} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by min(create_time)
